description: A refused save shows the raw server message 'This field changed since it was read; refresh its context'. It names no field, and there is no Refresh control. The actual fix (Base my draft on the latest version) sits above the form, off screen at 1440×900 once the person has scrolled to Save.
expected: 'Theo changed Status and Assignee after you started. Use your values anyway, or discard your edit.' with the rebase action in the error block itself.
suggested_fix: Map STALE_UPDATE for task.update to a message naming the changed fields and put 'Base my draft on the latest version' (or 'Keep my values') inside the error block.

description: After Dismiss on the error block, focus falls to document.body instead of moving to a nearby control.
expected: Focus moves to Save changes or the rebase button.
suggested_fix: On Dismiss, focus the form's submit button (or the notice's action).
